prompt: When trees develop leaves in the spring, 10 changes occur on the forest floor. Why does the development of leaves cause changes on the forest floor? (A) Rainfall increases. (B) Sunlight is reduced. (C) Wind speed increases. (D) Animal migration is stopped.
response:
The correct answer is (B) Sunlight is reduced.

When trees develop leaves in the spring, they become more dense and cover more of the canopy. This increased foliage blocks more sunlight from reaching the forest floor. As a result, the amount of light available for plants growing on the forest floor decreases, which can affect their growth and the overall ecosystem on the ground level. Reduced sunlight can also influence the temperature and moisture levels on the forest floor, further impacting the environment and the organisms that live there.
